first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Gray Racetrack
entities.identification: The gray paved road surface extending forward from the lower part of the main view and curving right between the slopes on both sides.

entities.name: Metal Guardrail
entities.identification: The silver-gray guardrails with multiple horizontal beam-like rails extending along both sides of the racetrack.

entities.name: Red-and-White Curb
entities.identification: The curved strip with alternating red and white sections between the road surface and the guardrail on the right side of the main view.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: The blue background between the tops of the slopes on both sides, also revealed in the final section through the small opening below and to the right of the Distant Gray Structure.

entities.name: Distant Gray Structure
entities.identification: The thick, slab-like gray structure between the slopes on both sides ahead, with an angular lower edge and a dark underside.

entities.name: Vehicle C
entities.identification: The low, bright yellow vehicle partially visible at the lower left of the main view, with black tires and silver wheel rims.

entities.name: Racing Interface Overlay
entities.identification: The orange text, top rear-view frame, lower-left route map, lower-right gauge, and green symbols on the right, all fixed in screen position.

entities.name: Slope Beside the Racetrack
entities.identification: The raised, steep slopes and locally exposed rock and soil flanking both sides of the racetrack, excluding the vegetation on their surfaces.

entities.name: Slope and Roadside Vegetation
entities.identification: The dark and light green covering on the slopes and the uneven tree-like silhouettes along the top of the left slope.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: The closer, broader-looking image of a silver-white vehicle in the top rear-view image.

entities.name: Vehicle D
entities.identification: The low vehicle image that is farther away and smaller in scale than Vehicle B in the top rear-view image; it is relatively dark in frame 0, while a light-colored upper portion and dark lower edge are discernible in the final frame.
